concept.name: Qualified Tender Change Intelligence
concept.targetBuyer: Small contractor or bid-development team reviewing public procurement opportunities
concept.buyerProblem: Teams waste time reviewing irrelevant republications and can miss material changes to opportunities they are actually qualified to pursue.
concept.centralClaim: A provenance-preserving pipeline can distinguish material field changes from republication noise and apply deterministic qualification rules to produce an explainable review queue.

authorizedScope: Build only the smallest vertical proof: bounded Find a Tender sample acquisition or recorded fixtures, ingest allowlist, consecutive-snapshot diff over declared fields, deterministic qualification profile, reason-coded output, provenance, tests, and a recorded run report. No scheduled production monitoring, document/PDF reconciliation, deployment, or marketing claims.
nextAction: Human decision required: authorize a bounded sanitized live-source evidence pass and reviewer artifacts, request revisions, or hold WS-001 at the completed fixture proof.

humanApproval.basis: User directed the workflow to stop waiting and proceed after reviewing the proposed Codex migration and revised WS-001 direction.

repairableConditions: Replace tag-count metrics with a diff-derived denominator over a declared field set.
Use a conservative fixed acquisition cadence and never probe for an undocumented rate ceiling.
Drop contactPoint and free-text fields before persistence through an explicit ingest allowlist.
Add a deterministic qualification profile distinct from change-event classification.
limitations: Current demand evidence is Upwork-adjacent rather than a verified sample of current logged-in Upwork postings.
The vertical proof does not claim production-scale, real-time, or complete amendment monitoring.
Document and PDF reconciliation is reserved for a later distinct portfolio iteration.
